0011_account_deletion_boundary.reason: The migration defines a tightly scoped account-deletion function whose DELETE statements run only when an authenticated user later requests deletion; applying the migration itself does not delete rows.
0011_account_deletion_boundary.rollbackPlan: Drop the three account-deletion boundary functions and restore the pre-release backup into a new database if the deployed application cannot safely return to the previous account-deletion path.

0012_soft_alex_power.reason: Better Auth 1.7 requires every credential and OAuth account identity to be scoped by a non-null issuer before the new unique identity index can be enforced.
0012_soft_alex_power.rollbackPlan: Restore the pre-migration backup before redeploying Better Auth 1.6; the previous release cannot create account rows after the issuer column becomes non-null.
